# Roadmap: Product Owner

## Role overview

Owns the backlog for a Scrum team and accepts finished work.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 3+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Agile & Scrum](../topics/agile.md)

## Also needed
